title: A Wookie Pelt Offering
description: As the Trandoshan crime boss Dokk Strassi descends the staircase an enters the throne room, Boba Fett turns to Fennec Shand and mutters: "That's weird, I used to work for him." "It's even weirder for him," she snaps back. In front of the dais, Strassi presents the pelt of a Wookiee and hands it to 8D8, as he offers a thousand tidings to Mos Espa's new daimyo. As the reptilian gangster walks away, Fett observes: "Even when a Trandoshan pays you a compliment, it sounds like a threat."
